baseline_tension: Nothing I found cuts against the LEN skew (-0.77, balanced) or the run-up (-6.0% over 20d) because nothing I found is directional at all — but I do think the LEN.B baseline's own expected_move_pct of 3.69% is wrong in MAGNITUDE and should not be relied on downstream: that median comes from seven prints in which B cushioned A's move by 0.4-1.25pp (Dec-2024 -3.97 vs -5.16, Jun-2025 -3.69 vs -4.46, Dec-2025 -3.58 vs -4.54), which was the A/B discount compressing from roughly 4.7% a year ago (implied by the two 52w highs, B $127.53 vs A $133.80) to the ~1.8% it has held all summer; that compression is finished, the last two prints showed a cushion of only 0.13pp (Mar-2026 +2.49 vs +2.62, Jun-2026 -4.77 vs -4.90), and so LEN.B should now move ~1.0x LEN rather than ~0.85x, i.e. its true expected absolute move for tonight is nearer LEN's option-implied 6.33% than 3.69%. That is a correction to our own baseline, not a market mispricing, so it belongs here and not in findings — and it has no sign, which is the other reason it cannot produce a non-zero expected_move_pct.
